ANKAMA.TITLE: Fullstack Developer
ANKAMA.DESC: Development of infrastructure and a complete interactive experience for Ankama games.
ANKAMA.LONG_DESC: At Ankama, I worked on the complete overhaul of the Twitch Extension infrastructure for DOFUS. This involved creating scalable micro-services with NestJS, capable of handling massive traffic spikes during community events. I also developed a dynamic Angular frontend interface allowing players to interact directly with the game from their favorite streams.

LINKPART.TITLE: Backend Developer (Apprenticeship)
LINKPART.DESC: Maintenance and evolution of a complex SaaS platform. Performance optimization via micro-services and event-driven architectures (AWS Lambda).
LINKPART.LONG_DESC: During my apprenticeship at LinkPart, I contributed to the development of Hub3e, a SaaS training management platform. I specifically worked on transitioning from a monolithic Symfony architecture to hybrid micro-services using AWS Lambda. I also implemented complex CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and deployment across multiple environments.
